name: McGrath Human Resources Group, Inc.
description: Human resource consulting, specializing in classification and compensation studies, job descriptions, and total rewards.

name: McMahon Associates, Inc.
description: McMahon is a full-service engineering, architecture and consulting firm. Our team is made up of civil engineers, transportation engineers, environmental experts, water resource managers, architects, structural engineers and electrical engineers. Our team of experts have the knowledge and experience to deliver results that will last for years to come.

name: Mead & Hunt
description: Mead & Hunt is a national, full-service architectural and engineering firm that has been serving markets for well over a century. The firm was established by hydroelectric and hydraulic engineer Daniel Mead in 1900. Since its founding, Mead & Hunt has grown significantly in size and diversity. The growth of the company has mirrored the changing markets of the country—as infrastructure needs expanded, so did we. Today, the firm provides services nationwide and employs more than 1,400 people.

name: Biodiesel (MEG Corp)
description: Municipal fleets are increasingly looking to green their fleets and operate more sustainably. Biodiesel is a clean, renewable, high performance alternative to diesel fuel that can be used in your existing diesel fleet without modifications. Visit the Biodiesel booth to find out how easy it is to reduce your fleet’s carbon footprint with biodiesel, while using a fuel that supports Wisconsin’s farmers and local economies. Biodiesel is good for the environment, good for your fleet and good for Wisconsin.

name: Midwest Renewable Energy Association
description: The MREA promotes renewable energy, energy efficiency, and sustainable living through education and demonstration. Together with partners around the Midwest, we work to expand renewable energy adoption through innovative programs, renewable energy training, and educational events. The MREA is a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization.

name: Miron Construction Co., Inc.
description: Miron Construction Co., Inc., one of the nation’s premier construction firms and industry leaders, provides innovative preconstruction, construction management, design-build, industrial, and general construction services nationwide. The forward-thinking, century-old private company is headquartered in Neenah, Wis., with Yard Operations located in Menasha, Wis., and regional offices in Eau Claire, Green Bay, Madison, Milwaukee, and Wausau, Wis., Cedar Rapids, Iowa, and Marquette, Mich. Miron is also the Official Provider of Construction Services for the Green Bay Packers and Lambeau Field. For more information, please visit www.miron-construction.com/

name: MPIC
description:
Property insurance designed for local government.
MPIC provides policy coverage specifically tailored to Wisconsin local government entities, helping municipalities address the unique property exposures they face.

name: MSA Professional Services, Inc.
description: MSA is a 100% employee-owned firm comprised of engineers, architects, planners, funding specialists, surveyors, GIS professionals, landscape architects, and environmental scientists — united by a shared commitment to building strong, lasting relationships with the communities we serve. With a firm of more than 500 dedicated professionals in 19 offices nationwide, our team has broad-spectrum expertise as well as niche market insights that are uniquely applicable to projects big or small, traditional or specialized. We have been honored to partner with Iowa communities since 1997, helping them to become better places to live, work, and play. For more information, visit www.msa-ps.com.

name: Mueller Communications, LLC
description:
Mueller Communications takes a strategic, 360° approach to communications to ensure the right message is delivered to the right audience at the right time.

We specialize in helping local governments across Wisconsin assess, improve, and elevate their communications strategies - empowering them to better connect with residents, build trust, and increase transparency.

name: Munibit
description: A Website Platform built for Local Governments. Munibit is one of the only website platforms built exclusively for small municipalities and counties. Purpose-built tools, transparent pricing, and an ADA-supportive design, all without the enterprise price tag.

name: Northwind Solar
description: Northwind Solar is a worker-owned solar installer based in Central Wisconsin, providing custom solar design, installation, service, and battery storage solutions for homes, businesses, farms, and public-sector organizations. Established in 2007, Northwind helps communities reduce energy costs, strengthen resilience, and advance long-term sustainability through practical, locally grounded solar solutions.

name: ODRA Road Sweepers
description: Since 2006, we've produced +1,600 sweepers for the US & Canada market. For more than a decade, our flagship sweeper has been sold under different names until 2020, when we began officially manufacturing and distributing under the brand, ODRA. With a focus on engineering, hydraulics, and straightforward design, our sweeper products are versatile enough to take on any job you need.

name: Public Administration Associates
description:
Public Administration Associates (PAA) has been recognized for almost 30 years as among the most trusted, skilled and effective local government consultants in Wisconsin and the Midwest.Our consultants are highly skilled practitioners who get the job done through unparalleled commitment to public service, the highest standards of service to its clients and the efficient use of client time and resources.

While we embrace the past, we are continually building for the future whether it be recruiting, assessing and developing talented local government leaders or in providing relevant advice and consultation on important issues facing our cities, villages, towns and counties.

name: raSmith
description: raSmith is a multidisciplinary engineering consulting firm established in the city of Brookfield, Wisconsin, in 1978. Our services include civil engineering, structural engineering, transportation and traffic, land surveying, geographic information systems (GIS), development management, landscape architecture, ecological services, construction services, LiDAR (3D laser scanning), and UAS (unmanned aircraft systems). We work on projects nationwide from our six locations in Wisconsin, Illinois, and California. The firm employs a staff of 220. For more information about raSmith, visit www.rasmith.com.

name: Ready Rebound
description: Ready Rebound combines sports medicine with hands-on navigation to improve the speed and quality of recovery, so workers return to duty 30% faster, and strengthen the organizations they serve.

name: Revelation PR, Advertising & Social Media
description: Revelation PR, Advertising & Social Media can help your municipality plan and execute community engagement activities for your developments, referendums, road projects, civic projects and infrastructure projects, and we can help you improve communications with your residents. We also provide crisis communications services and communications audits.

name: Robert E. Lee & Associates, Inc.
description: Since 1956, Robert E. Lee & Associates, Inc., is a full-service consulting firm assisting municipalities throughout Wisconsin with professional expertise in civil engineering, environmental compliance, surveying, and natural resources services.  We focus on providing exemplary service and plan production at a tremendous value to the clients we assist.  Services include civil, transportation, and municipal engineering, storm water management, construction administration and observation, surveying, grant writing, water and wastewater systems, brownfield redevelopment, ecological, and wetland delineations.

name: Ruekert & Mielke
description: Ruekert & Mielke, Inc. (R/M) is a 100% employee-owned civil engineering firm with more than 75 years of service to local communities and organizations. Our engineers, environmental specialists, agricultural experts, and technology consultants empower our clients to thrive by solving infrastructure challenges.

name: Safe Step LLC
description:
Safe Step LLC serves Wisconsin Municipalities by evaluating sidewalk infrastructure and repairing uneven sidewalk panels.

Why do Wisconsin Municipalities choose to work with Safe Step LLC?

They tell us we extend the life of their sidewalk infrastructure, provide transparency, and enable cost-effective decisions.

In 2025, we partnered with municipalities to help manage over $800 million in Wisconsin sidewalk assets, increasing compliance and community safety.

We look forward to talking with you!
